# Pre-Visit Clinical Intelligence Agent

> **Status: Phase 0 (environment) complete.** This project is being built incrementally, phase by phase, per `SPEC.md`. This README is a placeholder until Phase 8, when it will lead with the problem, an eval results table, and a screenshot.

**⚠️ Synthetic data only.** Every patient record used by this project is generated by [Synthea](https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea), MITRE's synthetic patient generator. No real patient data is used, stored, or connected to at any point. This is a portfolio/demonstration project, not a clinical system.

## Phase 0 — Environment

Brings up SQL Server 2022 (Developer Edition) and Qdrant in Docker, both free and requiring no account or credit card.

### Prerequisites

- Docker + Docker Compose (Docker Desktop on Windows, using the WSL2 backend)
- Python 3.11+

### Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# edit .env and set MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD to a value meeting SQL Server's
# complexity policy (8+ chars, upper+lower+digit or symbol)

docker compose up -d

python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate        # Windows
pip install -e ".[dev]"

python -m previsit.healthcheck
```

Expected output: a green `[OK]` line for both `SQL Server` and `Qdrant`.
